items.excerpt: 20th Century Studios will release Die Hard 2 and Die Hard with a Vengeance on 4K Ultra HD for the first time on December 1, in SteelBook editions.

items.title: Little House on the Prairie Wraps Season 2 and Adds 10 Cast Members
items.excerpt: Netflix's Little House on the Prairie has finished filming Season 2, with ten new actors joining the cast. No release date has been announced.

items.title: Netflix Sets Dates for Garuda: Dare to Dream, Carolina Caroline and Never Surrender
items.excerpt: Netflix will stream the Indonesian animated film Garuda: Dare to Dream from October 15, with Carolina Caroline on November 6 and Never Surrender on November 12.

items.title: Other Mommy Takes No. 1 Despite a D+ CinemaScore
items.excerpt: Universal's horror film Other Mommy is headed for about $28 million this weekend, even with a 20% critics score and a D+ from audiences.

items.title: The Social Reckoning Opens Soft With Around $6 Million
items.excerpt: Aaron Sorkin's The Social Reckoning earned about $2.1 million on Friday and is on course for roughly $6 million, far below The Social Network's debut.

items.title: Verity Debuts at No. 1 With $32.6 Million
items.excerpt: Verity topped the domestic box office with a $32.6 million opening weekend, ahead of Resident Evil and Heart of the Beast.

items.title: Digger Opens With $8 Million in Fifth Place
items.excerpt: Tom Cruise's Digger earned about $8 million in its opening weekend and reached $9.9 million by Tuesday.

items.title: Avengers: Endgame Encore Falls 83% in Second Weekend
items.excerpt: After topping the chart the week before, Avengers: Endgame Encore slid to seventh place with $4.4 million.

items.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Nears $955 Million Domestically
items.excerpt: After 68 days in theaters, Spider-Man: Brand New Day sits about $45 million short of $1 billion at the domestic box office.

items.title: Resident Evil Tops $127 Million as Holdovers Stay Strong
items.excerpt: Resident Evil, Heart of the Beast, Primetime and Forgotten Island continue to earn in the weeks after their openings.

items.title: Disclosure Day Arrives on Peacock October 9
items.excerpt: Disclosure Day, starring Emily Blunt, Josh O'Connor and Colman Domingo, began streaming on Peacock on October 9.

items.title: Netflix Renews A Different World and Crew Girl for Season 2
items.excerpt: Netflix has ordered second seasons of both A Different World and Crew Girl, according to TVLine.

items.title: TV Casting Roundup: The White Lotus , Darkwing Duck and More
items.excerpt: Helena Bonham Carter exits The White Lotus Season 4, Edie Falco leads a Fox legal drama, and Darkwing Duck is reviving at Disney+.

items.excerpt: From The Diplomat Season 4 to Nobody Wants This and Carrie, here are the key streaming and TV dates for the rest of October.
